target_claim: Lemma 4 (Chartrand and Harary 1967). A planar graph is outerplanar if and only if its blocks are outerplanar and its block-cutpoint tree is a path.
source_quote: Lemma 4 (Chartrand and Harary 1967). A planar graph is outerplanar if and only if its blocks are outerplanar and its block-cutpoint tree is a path.
